text: ShortsOS has run this workflow once, end to end, for real, and that single documented run is the whole of its public proof. One run is not a load or reliability proof, and the defects found in the Instagram connection during it were fixed reactively, against that live run, not beforehand. The review is a checkpoint on what gets published, not a promise of creative quality, performance or virality. When you compare vendors, ask each one to show you its review step in a real run, not only in a diagram.
